sentences.t: The Gulf escalation: Houthi drones struck near Saudi Arabia's Shaybah oilfield and hit Dammam's airport; Brent settled up 4% at $113.17, its highest close since May.

Wall Street's AI bill: the S&P 500 fell 1.2% and the Nasdaq 2.6%, its worst day since June, after Meta's results showed AI spending pushing free cash flow negative - Meta fell about 7% despite a revenue beat.
India's third straight fall: Sensex -460 to 73,249, Nifty -124 to 22,688, the rupee snapped an eight-session rise at 94.82, and the 10-year yield closed at 7.46%.
Banks were the day's relative winners.
Jio closes today: day two settled at 5.57 times subscribed on BSE data (QIB 13.29x, retail 1.54x).
Bidding ends 5 PM, UPI mandates 7 PM; allotment Monday, listing Wednesday.

Four listings today: Zetwerk (grey premium faded to ₹1), Tonbo Imaging (subscribed 135.9 times), Bonfiglioli Transmissions (46 times) and Sahajanand Medical Technologies (BSE listing notice, 22 Oct) open this morning.

Thursday's results: Swiggy's loss came in wider than estimated even as food delivery posted record margins; HPCL swung to profit against a feared loss but earnings fell 9% on the year as crude squeezed margins; Colgate missed.
Today to watch: Infosys, Dr Reddy's and IndusInd Bank report; the first-hour opens of the four listings; Jio's final subscription print after 5 PM; the Fed decides Wednesday.
